input: Find STEM, science, coding, academic, cooking and enrichment summer camps and summer programs for kids and teens in or near Weaverville, Woodfin, Leicester, Candler, Barnardsville, Marshall, Mars Hill and Hot Springs, NC. Search the web thoroughly (several searches with different wording and town names) and list every organization you find.
searches: Weaverville Woodfin STEM science summer camp 2026

candidates.name: Madison County Cooperative Extension / 4-H
candidates.note: 2026 Summer Fun offered cooking, creek ecology, animal science, sewing and riding programs for ages 5–18.

candidates.name: Madison County Community Learning Centers
candidates.note: Woodson Branch Nature School offered 2026 K–8 summer camps, with pickup available in Marshall and Weaverville.

candidates.name: Earth Path Education
candidates.note: 2026 programs included Nature Sisters for girls 8–11 in Candler and teen watershed-restoration immersions in Marshall.

candidates.name: Ruby Ranch
candidates.note: 2026 full-day working-ranch camp for ages 6–16 included gardening, cooking, art, creek exploration and riding.

candidates.name: Buncombe County Cooperative Extension / 4-H
candidates.note: 2026 Summer Fun day camps covered cooking, canning, agriculture, world cultures and art; center on Mount Carmel Road.

candidates.name: Buncombe County Schools
candidates.note: Agriculture Career Exploration day camp ran July 6–9, 2026, for rising BCS grades 5–8; prior camp based on Bingham Road.

candidates.name: Zaniac Asheville
candidates.note: 2026 STEM and math summer camps included three weeks at UNC Asheville plus sessions at the Biltmore Park campus.

candidates.name: University of North Carolina Asheville
candidates.note: Offers overnight high-school pre-college programs and SkillSet maker camps for ages 8+; 2027 pre-college interest form posted.

candidates.name: Asheville Museum of Science
candidates.note: 2026 science camps for rising K–5 covered nature, computer programming and chemistry, with weekly or single-day registration.

candidates.name: The Educational Garden Project
candidates.note: June–August 2026 garden camp for ages 6–10 and CIT program for ages 11–16 included cooking, gardening and animal care.

candidates.name: The New Classical Academy
candidates.note: Four themed weeklong 2026 camps for rising K4/kindergarten–grade 5, 9 a.m.–3 p.m., on Sand Hill Road.

candidates.name: Asheville Parks & Recreation
candidates.note: 2026 summer camps included science, creative and general enrichment; 2027 schedules are due February 1, 2027.

candidates.name: YMCA of Western North Carolina
candidates.note: 2026 Adventure Camp served ages 9–15 at Beaverdam and Enka-district locations; also offers themed Discovery camps.

candidates.name: The North Carolina Arboretum
candidates.note: 2026 Discovery Camps provided supervised outdoor learning; youth education focuses on science and environmental exploration.

candidates.name: Evergreen Community Charter School
candidates.note: 2026 Summer Adventures for rising K–9 combined enrichment classes, outdoor activities and field trips.

candidates.name: Asheville Mountain Kitchen
candidates.note: Kids’ hands-on baking and cooking summer camps were listed for July 2025; official site retains its kids’ camp section.
